summary: Iteration 52: Verified Discord + WhatsApp alert channels and Custom Domain docs additions. Backend pytest 4/4 passed (test_iter52_discord_whatsapp.py): PUT /api/admin/deploy/alert-channels persists discord_webhook + whatsapp_webhook alongside existing slack + generic; GET echoes them back; POST /api/admin/deploy/alert-channels/test returns sent_to with discord:true + whatsapp:true; creating an incident (POST /api/admin/deploy/status-incidents) triggers _dispatch_alerts and fires httpx POSTs to both httpbin.org/post and httpbin.org/anything — backend logs confirm 200 OK on multiple POSTs to both URLs during the run. Frontend Playwright: logged in as admin@stitches.app, opened Admin -> Deployment. Channels panel now exposes all 4 inputs (slack-webhook-input, discord-webhook-input, whatsapp-webhook-input, webhook-url-input). Filling discord + whatsapp + Save shows 'Alert channels saved' toast; after full page reload values persist (discord='https://httpbin.org/post', whatsapp='https://httpbin.org/anything'). Clicking 'Send test alert' produces a toast mentioning discord + whatsapp (both keywords present in body). Custom Domain: domain-toggle-btn opens domain-panel; domain-cname element shows 'status  →  stitches-connect.preview.emergentagent.com'; domain-cname-copy successfully copies the target host to the clipboard (verified via navigator.clipboard.readText). Regression: incidents-toggle-btn + embed-toggle-btn open; public /status renders (1055 chars). Post-test cleanup: all four alert channel fields cleared and saved (verified via GET returning empty strings) and no residual test incidents left investigating.
seed_data_creation: Transient: TEST_iter52_dw incident (created + resolved), alert_channels discord=https://httpbin.org/post, whatsapp=https://httpbin.org/anything (all cleared post-test). Final DB state: all 4 alert channels empty; no residual TEST_ incidents in investigating state.
